standard.trigger: Applies where deployed code depends on persistent structured state whose schema or compatibility contract can evolve independently. Stateless Clanks, schema-less Clanks, and ephemeral stores with no evolving compatibility boundary are N/A.
standard.requirement: A Clank whose trigger is met MUST prevent normal work from being admitted while the deployed code and required persistent-state contract are known to be incompatible. It MUST determine compatibility at a barrier that occurs before normal incompatible work is accepted, fail closed on known incompatibility, and preserve evidence sufficient to identify compatibility gating as the reason normal work was refused. The barrier may be deploy preflight, startup, first normal transaction, or another trustworthy gate; deployment ordering and mechanism are not prescribed.
operative_contract: fail closed on unknown or known-incompatible state
migrate only through the canonical mechanism where allowed
verify resulting compatibility before admitting normal work
do not mutate state merely to discover compatibility
standard.forbidden_interpretation: Migration-framework presence, process/database/table existence, create_all completion, connectivity, or deployment-command success is not compatibility proof by itself.

migration_vs_compatibility.framework_rule: A migration framework or auto-DDL routine only changes state. It is not evidence that the running code can safely perform normal work against that state.
migration_vs_compatibility.barrier_rule: Conformance requires a trustworthy pre-normal-work decision, fail-closed known incompatibility, and an auditable refusal reason across every operational entry point.
migration_vs_compatibility.implication: All seven targets remain planning candidates; none is marked conforming by this artifact. Semiconductor and the numbered-SQLite targets have useful primitives, but each still needs a barrier-focused re-audit.

applicability_assessment.basis: Each target has durable structured state that survives restart/deployment and has an evolving schema or compatibility boundary. One-shot scheduling, QC archives, campaign stores, and sidecars do not make the main trigger N/A.

failed migration never records or infers state READY

fresh empty state/bootstrap works where explicitly supported
